script.title: SENDING SUSHI BACK
script.story_hook: One bite tells her the salmon needs more flame.
script.intro_zh: 一口就發現鮭魚還得再烤一下。
script.welcome_en: Welcome back, friends! Today we send a dish back politely.
script.welcome_zh: 歡迎回來，朋友們！今天練習怎麼禮貌地退回料理。
script.outro: Polite complaints get results. Try these lines out loud!
script.outro_zh: 有禮地反映最有用的，把這些句子大聲練起來！
script.practice_intro_en: Let's repeat the whole scene together.
script.practice_intro_zh: 我們把整段對話一起跟讀一遍。

script.char_b_description: a polite young man in his mid twenties with neatly trimmed black hair, wearing a navy server jacket over a white collared shirt, bowing slightly beside the table

script.youtube_title_en: "You Know Your Sushi!" — Sending Back Undercooked Sushi
script.youtube_description:
餐點沒熟，該怎麼不尷尬地請服務生處理？這集 18 句壽司店對話示範禮貌抱怨的完整流程：描述問題、請內場確認、更換料理、連醋飯溫度都講得清清楚楚。美式口語搭配繁體中文翻譯與 IPA 標音，後半段逐句跟讀，聽一遍就敢開口。
#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish
訂閱我們的頻道，每天一集，讓英語變成你的直覺！
script.youtube_description_en:
Food arrives undercooked and you don't want to make a scene? This 18-line sushi-bar scene walks you through a polite complaint: describing the issue, asking the server to check with the kitchen, swapping dishes, and even mentioning rice temperature. American English with IPA plus a repeat-after-me section.
#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish
Subscribe for a new episode every day!
script.youtube_title_ref: 【🎬沉浸式英文動畫】🍣壽司英文｜描述沒熟・內場確認・更換料理｜聽完就會反映｜🌱A2 初級英文｜💡不用背，多聽就會用｜🎧聽力口說練習｜後段逐句跟讀
script.youtube_description_ref:
📌 影片簡介：
鮭魚中間還沒熟，要忍了吃完還是開口？
怎麼說才能既有禮、又讓內場認真處理？

這一集帶大家走進安靜講究的壽司吧檯，跟著顧客從描述問題、請服務生確認、討論醋飯溫度，到最後換成炙烤鮭魚，全程都是自然的美式英語。

你會聽到：
🍣 描述問題：例如「the salmon seems undercooked.」、「Good sushi rice should be body-warm.」
🙋 禮貌反映：例如「Can I ask the kitchen for you?」、「Completely fair.」
🔄 更換料理：例如「I could just switch to tuna.」、「Enjoy the rest of dinner!」

後半段是逐句聽力加上跟讀練習 🎧，先聽一遍，再跟著一句一句唸，把整段對話變成自然的口語直覺。

🌱 適合 A2 初級英文學習者：不用死背，跟著情境反覆聽，自然就會用。

好好吃一頓飯，從勇敢開口開始！
script.thumbnail_action: holding chopsticks over a seared salmon nigiri

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Excuse me, could you take a look at this?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪkˈskjuːz mi kʊd ju teɪk ə lʊk æt ðɪs/
dialogue.zh: 不好意思，能請你看一下這盤嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Of course, is everything all right?
dialogue.zh: 當然沒問題，一切都還好嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Well, the salmon seems undercooked in the middle.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛl ðə ˈsæmən simz ˌʌndərˈkʊkt ɪn ðə ˈmɪdəl/
dialogue.zh: 嗯，這塊鮭魚中間看起來沒熟。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Oh, I'm sorry. Does it look raw to you?
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ aɪm ˈsɑri dʌz ɪt lʊk rɔ tə ju/
dialogue.zh: 噢，很抱歉。您覺得看起來生的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A little, yes. I'd rather not risk it tonight.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈlɪtəl jɛs aɪd ˈræðər nɑt rɪsk ɪt təˈnaɪt/
dialogue.zh: 有一點。今晚我可不想冒險。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Completely fair. Can I ask the kitchen for you?
dialogue.phonetic: /kəmˈplitli fɛr kæn aɪ æsk ðə ˈkɪtʃən fɔr ju/
dialogue.zh: 完全應該。我可以替您去問內場嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Please. And maybe check the rice too, um...
dialogue.phonetic: /pliz ænd ˈmeɪbi tʃɛk ðə raɪs tu ʌm/
dialogue.zh: 麻煩你了。還有醋飯我也想說一下，呃……

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: What's up with the rice? Is it cold?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌts ʌp wɪð ðə raɪs ɪz ɪt koʊld/
dialogue.zh: 醋飯怎麼了嗎？是太冰了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sort of. Good sushi rice should be body-warm, right?
dialogue.phonetic: /sɔrt əv ɡʊd ˈsuʃi raɪs ʃʊd bi ˈbɑdi wɜrm raɪt/
dialogue.zh: 有點像。好的壽司醋飯應該是接近體溫，對吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You know your sushi! Let me talk to the chef.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju noʊ jʊr ˈsuʃi lɛt mi tɔk tə ðə ʃɛf/
dialogue.zh: 您真內行！讓我來去跟主廚說。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thanks, no rush. The eel roll was cooked well.
dialogue.phonetic: /θæŋks noʊ rʌʃ ði il roʊl wʌz kʊkt wɛl/
dialogue.zh: 謝謝，不急。鰻魚卷倒是烤得剛剛好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Back with news: the chef will re-sear it.
dialogue.phonetic: /bæk wɪð nuz ðə ʃɛf wɪl ri sɪr ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 有好消息：主廚願意重新炙烤。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Or honestly, I could just switch to tuna.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɔr ˈɑnəstli aɪ kʊd dʒʌst swɪtʃ tə ˈtunə/
dialogue.zh: 或者說實話，我也可以直接換成鮪魚。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The chef suggests seared tuna, if you prefer.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ʃɛf səɡˈdʒɛsts sɪrd ˈtunə ɪf ju prɪˈfɜr/
dialogue.zh: 主廚提議換成炙燒鮪魚，看您喜歡哪個。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That sounds perfect. And the rice, no problem?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt saʊndz ˈpɜrfɪkt ænd ðə raɪs noʊ ˈprɑbləm/
dialogue.zh: 聽起來很棒。那醋飯也沒問題了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He'll warm a fresh batch. Five minutes, okay?
dialogue.phonetic: /hil wɔrm ə frɛʃ bættʃ faɪv ˈmɪnɪts oʊˈkeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 他會重新溫一份，五分鐘左右，可以嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You've been great, thank you both so much.
dialogue.phonetic: /jubɪn ɡreɪt θæŋk ju boʊθ su mʌtʃ/
dialogue.zh: 你處理得很好，替我謝謝你們兩位。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Of course. Enjoy the rest of dinner!
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌv ˈkɔrs ɛnˈdʒɔɪ ðə rɛst əv ˈdɪnər/
dialogue.zh: 應該的，請繼續享受晚餐！
